Image 3 is matte museum illustration STYLE sample only; do not copy its building, colors or black backdrop. Subject: jp_saihoji_garden. Material observations: Dark muted olive pond water, many deep and bright moss-green banks and rocks, soft natural green tree canopy, charcoal gray stone edges. Preserve the photographed irregular shore and mossy small rock island. Apply restrained matte pigment areas to Image 1 only, retain fine charcoal outlines, slight texture only within solid forms. Entire exterior background, empty sky and true openings should be perfectly flat opaque PURE WHITE #FFFFFF or native transparency if returned. No black background, haze, gradient, paper texture, glow, cast shadow, checkerboard, people, labels, extra buildings, invented garden features, frame or watermark. This is colorization, not redesign.
